paragraphs.text: Now late on the sabbath day, as it began to dawn toward the first [day] of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
paragraphs.original: Ὀψὲ δὲ σαββάτων, τῇ ἐπιφωσκούσῃ εἰς μίαν σαββάτων, ἦλθεν Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία θεωρῆσαι τὸν τάφον.
paragraphs.translit: Opse de sabbatōn, tē epiphōskousē eis mian sabbatōn, ēlthen Mariam hē Magdalēnē kai hē allē Maria theōrēsai ton taphon.

paragraphs.text: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας· ἄγγελος γὰρ κυρίου καταβὰς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν ἀπεκύλισε τὸν λίθον καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou seismos egeneto megas· angelos gar kyriou katabas ex ouranou kai proselthōn apekylise ton lithon kai ekathēto epanō autou.

paragraphs.text: His appearance was as lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
paragraphs.original: ἦν δὲ ἡ εἰδέα αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀστραπὴ καὶ τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ λευκὸν ὡς χιών.
paragraphs.translit: ēn de hē eidea autou hōs astrapē kai to endyma autou leukon hōs chiōn.

paragraphs.text: and for fear of him the watchers did quake, and became as dead men.
paragraphs.original: ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθησαν οἱ τηροῦντες καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ὡς νεκροί.
paragraphs.translit: apo de tou phobou autou eseisthēsan hoi tērountes kai egenēthēsan hōs nekroi.

paragraphs.text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye; for I know that ye seek Jesus, who hath been crucified.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν ταῖς γυναιξίν· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὑμεῖς, οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ζητεῖτε·
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de ho angelos eipen tais gynaixin· Mē phobeisthe hymeis, oida gar hoti Iēsoun ton estaurōmenon zēteite·

paragraphs.text: He is not here; for he is risen, even as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε, ἠγέρθη γὰρ καθὼς εἶπεν· δεῦτε ἴδετε τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἔκειτο·
paragraphs.translit: ouk estin hōde, ēgerthē gar kathōs eipen· deute idete ton topon hopou ekeito·

paragraphs.text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples, He is risen from the dead; and lo, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ταχὺ πορευθεῖσαι εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἰδοὺ προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε· ἰδοὺ εἶπον ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: kai tachy poreutheisai eipate tois mathētais autou hoti Ēgerthē apo tōn nekrōn, kai idou proagei hymas eis tēn Galilaian, ekei auton opsesthe· idou eipon hymin.

paragraphs.text: And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ταχὺ ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου μετὰ φόβου καὶ χαρᾶς μεγάλης ἔδραμον ἀπαγγεῖλαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai apelthousai tachy apo tou mnēmeiou meta phobou kai charas megalēs edramon apangeilai tois mathētais autou.

paragraphs.text: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἰησοῦς ὑπήντησεν αὐταῖς λέγων· Χαίρετε· αἱ δὲ προσελθοῦσαι ἐκράτησαν αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou Iēsous hypēntēsen autais legōn· Chairete· hai de proselthousai ekratēsan autou tous podas kai prosekynēsan autō.

paragraphs.text: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
paragraphs.original: τότε λέγει αὐταῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε· ὑπάγετε ἀπαγγείλατε τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἵνα ἀπέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, κἀκεῖ με ὄψονται.
paragraphs.translit: tote legei autais ho Iēsous· Mē phobeisthe· hypagete apangeilate tois adelphois mou hina apelthōsin eis tēn Galilaian, kakei me opsontai.

paragraphs.text: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.
paragraphs.original: Πορευομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδού τινες τῆς κουστωδίας ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν ἅπαντα τὰ γενόμενα.
paragraphs.translit: Poreuomenōn de autōn idou tines tēs koustōdias elthontes eis tēn polin apēngeilan tois archiereusin hapanta ta genomena.

paragraphs.text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave much money unto the soldiers,
paragraphs.original: καὶ συναχθέντες μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων συμβούλιόν τε λαβόντες ἀργύρια ἱκανὰ ἔδωκαν τοῖς στρατιώταις
paragraphs.translit: kai synachthentes meta tōn presbyterōn symboulion te labontes argyria hikana edōkan tois stratiōtais

paragraphs.text: saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
paragraphs.original: λέγοντες· Εἴπατε ὅτι Οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς ἐλθόντες ἔκλεψαν αὐτὸν ἡμῶν κοιμωμένων·
paragraphs.translit: legontes· Eipate hoti Hoi mathētai autou nyktos elthontes eklepsan auton hēmōn koimōmenōn·

paragraphs.text: And if this come to the governor`s ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἀκουσθῇ τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος, ἡμεῖς πείσομεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους ποιήσομεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean akousthē touto epi tou hēgemonos, hēmeis peisomen auton kai hymas amerimnous poiēsomen.

paragraphs.text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying was spread abroad among the Jews, [and continueth] until this day.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια ἐποίησαν ὡς ἐδιδάχθησαν. Καὶ διεφημίσθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de labontes ta argyria epoiēsan hōs edidachthēsan. Kai diephēmisthē ho logos houtos para Ioudaiois mechri tēs sēmeron hēmeras.

paragraphs.text: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
paragraphs.original: Οἱ δὲ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,
paragraphs.translit: Hoi de hendeka mathētai eporeuthēsan eis tēn Galilaian eis to oros hou etaxato autois ho Iēsous,

paragraphs.text: And when they saw him, they worshipped [him]; but some doubted.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν προσεκύνησαν, οἱ δὲ ἐδίστασαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai idontes auton prosekynēsan, hoi de edistasan.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus came to them and spake unto them, saying, All authority hath been given unto me in heaven and on earth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἐδόθη μοι πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς·
paragraphs.translit: kai proselthōn ho Iēsous elalēsen autois legōn· Edothē moi pasa exousia en ouranō kai epi tēs gēs·

paragraphs.text: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
paragraphs.original: πορευθέντες οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος,
paragraphs.translit: poreuthentes oun mathēteusate panta ta ethnē, baptizontes autous eis to onoma tou patros kai tou hyiou kai tou hagiou pneumatos,

paragraphs.text: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
paragraphs.original: διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: didaskontes autous tērein panta hosa eneteilamēn hymin· kai idou egō methʼ hymōn eimi pasas tas hēmeras heōs tēs synteleias tou aiōnos.
